entities.summary: Joseph Carl "JC" Tretter Jr. is an American former professional football player who was a center in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Cornell Big Red and was selected by the Green Bay Packers in the fourth round of the 2013 NFL draft. Tretter is the Executive Director of the NFL Players Association (NFLPA), which he also served as president of from 2020 to 2024.
